svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three rows, each with a polyhedron wireframe on the left and a magenta bar of the same length on the right. Row one is the icosahedron: 12 vertices, the bar cut into 12 pieces of 60°. Row two cuts every face into 4 and pushes the vertices out to the sphere: 42 vertices, 42 pieces, the longest about 18°. Row three cuts every face into 16: 162 vertices, 162 thin stripes, the longest about 5°. All three bars end together at 720°. A tag in the bottom right marks this as a literature result.
